info.title: ShipRust API
info.description: Create and download ShipRust projects with a personal API key. Create a key in Settings and send it as `Authorization: Bearer sr_...`. Every error is a JSON object with an `error` message. Guide: https://shiprust.com/docs/api

Account.description: The account behind an API key.

paid.description:
Whether the account can create and download projects: a lifetime
purchase or an active admin role.

CreateRequest.description: A new project. Only `name` is required; omitted fields take the new-project form's defaults (`GET /api/v1/options`). Unknown fields and capabilities are rejected with 422.

include_api.description: A JSON API for your users, with personal API keys and bearer authentication.

include_auth.description:
Accounts: sign-up with email verification, sign-in, passkeys, two-factor,
settings, a dashboard and an admin panel. `false` generates a public site
and leaves out the options that act for a signed-in user (`include_google`, `include_github`,
`include_api`, `include_mcp`, `include_storage`, `include_stripe`,
`include_qdrant`), whatever they say.

include_github.description:
Sign up and sign in with GitHub, connect GitHub to an existing account from
settings, and confirm sensitive changes with GitHub for accounts without a
password. Hidden until the owner configures their GitHub OAuth App.

include_google.description:
Sign up and sign in with Google, connect Google to an existing account from
settings, and confirm sensitive changes with Google for accounts without a
password. Hidden until the owner configures their Google client.

include_mcp.description:
An MCP server at `/mcp`. Omitted or null follows `include_api`, so
turning the API off never needs a second field; `true` without the API is a 422.

include_qdrant.description:
Qdrant vector search scoped per user. Off by default: most products
do not need a vector database.

include_storage.description: File storage for user uploads, with a profile picture upload as the example.

include_stripe.description: Hosted Checkout, billing portal and webhooks.

name.description: Replaces ShipRust in the generated project.

posthog_features.description: Keys from the options' `posthog_features`; all by default. An empty list turns PostHog off.

sentry_features.description: Keys from the options' `sentry_features`; all by default. An empty list turns Sentry off.

slug.description:
Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter. Derived
from `name` when empty. Unique per account.

Defaults.description: What `POST /api/v1/projects` uses for each omitted field.

ErrorBody.description: The body of every error response.

error.description: What went wrong, written for a person.
error.example: This API key is invalid or has been revoked.

Options.description: The generator's choices, their defaults and the input limits.

template_version.description: The template revision new projects are generated from.

Project.description: A generated project and the choices it was generated with.

download_url.description: The project's zip, `GET` with the same key.

template_version.description: The template revision the project's zip is generated from.

api_key.description: A personal API key from Settings, or an OAuth 2.1 access token obtained through the authorization server described at /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server. Cookies are never accepted.
